title: Hunts FH-018: Ship safe publish and reporting

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 1, Moderation. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Require site permission, report button, moderation queue, closure workflow and emergency pause. Done when: Operator can contain unsafe Hunt and active players can see closure without losing prior progress. Requires: FH-013, FH-016. Owner role: Operations.
